recommendations.description: Fix stale closure bugs in App.tsx state management. All state updates in addTodo, toggleTodo, and deleteTodo must use functional form (setTodos(prev => ...)) to prevent data corruption.
Add test infrastructure (Jest + Testing Library) and write tests for core business logic: TodoManager operations, state management, and form submission. Current test coverage is 0%.
Implement input validation and sanitization in TodoForm to prevent XSS attacks and invalid data entry. Add validation for empty inputs and potentially malicious content.
Replace Date.now() ID generation with crypto.randomUUID() or similar robust unique identifier to prevent ID collisions when adding multiple todos quickly.
Add ARIA labels, semantic HTML elements (main, ul, li), and keyboard navigation support throughout the application to improve accessibility for screen readers and keyboard users.
Extract business logic into custom hooks and utility functions. Separate filtering, sorting, and validation logic from components to improve testability and maintainability.
Add user confirmation for delete actions, empty state messages, and form validation feedback to improve user experience and prevent accidental data loss.
Implement localStorage persistence to prevent data loss on page refresh. Add useEffect hooks to save and restore todos from localStorage.
Optimize rendering performance using useCallback for event handlers and useMemo for expensive filtering/sorting operations to prevent unnecessary re-renders.
Add JSDoc documentation, improve error handling with ErrorBoundary, and extract configuration constants (priority options, colors) to centralized files.
